Original review:
As a ProAdvisor, I have used with app for YEARS and have recommended it to many clients. It USED to work perfectly. Then they started the beta testing rollout. The app kept freezing and you couldn’t enter notes. Then they forced the conversion to the new format and this app hasn’t worked since. reviews.title: Extremely Tedious & Slow

However, even if you select the location before clocking in it will still make you go back & select the location & clock in all over again anyways. I clicked refresh and it didn’t switch pages, so I just closed the app and reopened it. Then the page just wouldn’t load. I kinda went on with my day assuming maybe my wifi was just bad, but when I went back to check, I was still clocked in and it wouldn’t clock me out, it still won’t. I have been clocked in for 30+ hours because the app will not let me clock out and every time I reach that refresh page, clicking the refresh button does nothing.

reviews.title: Limited reception = bad experience.
reviews.text: If the app wasn’t so reliant on reception at all times it would probably be much better. But for anyone that actually uses the app in the field, it’s painfully apparent that before I get to use the app at all it needs to check in with the server and that really messes up the functionality of the app. Sometimes I’ll be typing in a description for a time clock event and it will glitch out and act like I started typing in the middle of my first word because it didn’t pick up my first few letters. This is because it’s sitting there and reaching out to the server therefore it is somehow ignoring my input. Also when I open the app and I have limited reception or if I have a low WiFi signal, it’ll just sit there spinning and won’t load the app because it can’t first ping the servers. I don’t care how much information it wants to share with the servers but it should prioritize loading the app and giving me access prioritize my input over pinging the server.

reviews.title: 1 star because I can't give zero stars

(It better not be collecting/selling my data when I'm not clocked in. Let me find out it is.) It hasn't even been two weeks since the company switched to this service and I, myself, have had to go to my manager more than a handful of times to have them manually go in and input my hours. I have a degree in computer and electronics engineering - I know computers and this app is not "it."

reviews.title: ADP is better
reviews.text: Never had to many issues with  payroll timing when using ADP. But they say change can be good but I am still waiting to see the benefits of this change so far. Many on staff have grown accustomed to receiving their pay a day earlier most times. Submitting payroll funds well ahead to ensure a smooth distribution of funds. With my employers switch to QBs, my staff will be luck to receive their deposit by 6am come payday. A couple of times the deposits were late. Like, afternoon late… I really respect my staffers and I do not want to make excuses why they have to commute to work on payday with no pay. Rules are rules the payday is payday. But this seems like an unnecessary step backwards when most other services do not have this issue. I wouldn’t recommend this app to other HR professionals.
